en: Are ya gonna tell me, or not?
You'll have to pony up a fair payment. So listen good.
See the serious-looking inmate to your right? Don't turn your head! Just do a quick glance with your eyes, you nitwit.
I need you to get some goods from him. Don't ask what they are, that's none of your concern. Just make sure no one sees you do it.
All right, sure. Next?
Take the goods to the guard standing in front of and to the left of you. You'll need to be stealthy about that move as well.
Don't just walk up to him. Pass it through the fence. Don't worry, it's small enough.
I got lots of friends here, like those two. But I got even more enemies.
So again, don't do anything to draw suspicion.
Yeah, I got it. It's a deal.
(First, I get whatever-the-hell-it-is from that guy.)
Approach the man without arousing suspicion. Running near other inmates and guards will draw attention, so walk when you're close to them.
You're awake.
Things can be replaced; people can't. You're aware of that, aren't you? *sigh* You're lucky to be alive. Get your stuff sorted; I'll hold your gun and shells.
All snow gear must be moved to the Item Box or Inventory.
Let me know when you're going to the mountain. And be better prepared next time!
Finally, you're awake! A passing hunter found you. How lucky is that? I have to say, you do some pretty risky stuff.
Things can be replaced; people can't. You're aware of that, aren't you? *sigh* You're lucky to be alive. If you want, I'll hold your gun and shells.
Well, well. You're alive.
Get some proper rest. I'll hold your gun and shells.
Let me know when you're going to the mountain.
The road's been reopened.
Good. You can leave town now. Baba will be fine.
But isn't Yama-oroshi still roamin' the mountain?
That's my problem.
All right. ...Lemme ask ya somethin'.
Why do ya keep after Yama-oroshi?
That's really none of your concern. Let it be.
Okay. I get the feelin' that some day you're gonna end up tellin' me anyway. 'Cause we're alike in certain ways, ya know.
Hmph. You're entitled to your opinion.
But for now, you can hurry off to Tsukimino, or stay and hunt. Just let me know what you decide.
How's the village? Saejima, go see if they've plowed the snow from the road.
That trader is pretty much your only option for buying and selling goods. Go introduce yourself!
I made some snares. Saejima, you ready for this mountain?
Nah, hold on a bit.
All right. Just let me know when you're ready.
Yeah. Ready.
Ready for the mountain?
All right, let's go!
Fine. If you want, I'll hold your snow gear for now.
You're back. You done now?
Good. We'll go trapping, then. For rabbits. That's the best food for Baba. It'll help him get his strength back.
I'm sorry, Aniki. To require so much of you.
Don't worry about it.
Anyway, I made some snares. Are you ready to go to the mountain?
Mind waitin' a bit?
Not at all. Just tell me when you're ready.
All right, let's get a move on.
You mentioned you had a favor to return... To someone who gave you some food, I believe.
So are you gonna go do that or not?
(He's right. Gotta go see Nishina-san.)
I'll teach you how to trap rabbits when you get back.
Why? Ain't much meat on those li'l critters. Why not try for deer?
Rabbit meat is much more tender. It'll be easier for Baba to digest.
The fur will be very useful as well.
Well, you'd know best.
Go take care of your business. I'll make some rabbit snares.
They'll be finished by the time you get back.
Did you not find the person you were looking for?
If it makes it any easier, I can hold your gun and shells. You might as well get your stuff sorted, too.
Let me know when you're good and ready. The mountain is not something to be trifled with.
Okudera-han...
Don't thank me. Nishina's the one you should thank.
Didn't mean to be a burden... Sorry.
You should be.
Kihachi was grateful, though.
Heh, a silver lining to the fact I couldn't even save myself.
Forget silver linings⑬let it be a lesson! By the way, I've got your gun and shells here. So don't worry about them; just focus on resting up.
Alright...
You got 2,000 experience points.
All right. What're we gonna do, Okudera-han?
I don't know. We'll just have to keep an eye on the situation for now and deal with it when the time comes.
Y'know, from what I've heard, hunting is one-sided slaughter.
That's not an inaccurate description.
(Wish it could be more fair.)
But that doesn't apply to Yama-oroshi. He could kill a man as easily as we might kill any game.
So he'd be a fair fight, then.
Enough talk. I'm going to sleep.
...Alright.
Animals in the area are shown on the minimap.
What, you came back without finishing your task?
You're alive⑬that's a surprise! What happened?
Plugged him squarely. From now on, we'll know where Yama-oroshi is.
That's great news. Rest up; I asked a lot of you.
Won't argue with ya.
Unsteadiness while shooting is reduced.
When you're ready, we'll search for Yama-oroshi's den.
You're feelin' up to it already?
I may not be able to hold a gun, but I've got you. If you're willing to help an old man get around, that is.
Ha, you're puttin' a lot of faith in me. But no worries, old man, I got your back.
I'll start packing. Just tell me when you're ready.
"Okudera's Escort" was added.
If you want, I can hold your gun and shells. You might as well get your stuff sorted, too.
Hm... the other side of the canyon. Well, now that we know the location of its den, there'll be plenty of other opportunities.
(Okudera-han backed off so quickly. That's not like 'im.)
I'll cook supper, Saejima. Why don't you go see how the village is faring?
Sure, it's somethin' to do.
(Kihachi-san sent the cops packin', and then he took a lotta heat for wastin' their time.)
(The bears from all these nearby mountains are still hangin' around.)
(But at least Okudera-han's safe, and Yama-oroshi ain't about to go near people anytime soon.)
Nothing. Thanks.
Don't mention it.
You got 5,000 experience points.

Unsteadiness while shooting is minimized.
Health loss from the cold is suppressed.
Okudera has given his blessing to trek around the mountain freely.
You've been handling rifles a good long while.
What about it?
I'd like to see your skill with my own eyes. Let me know when you've got the time.
"Hunter Test" was added to the list of missions.
Well done, you've learned. As for the deer you shot, we'll share it with the village. That will show our gratitude for the animal's sacrifice.
My learnin' is all thanks to you, Okudera-han. And I still got lotsa catchin' up to do.
Don't be modest. You're ready for this.
From now on, use this rifle on the mountain.
You got a Vertical Double Rifle (Extreme).
Use it only when you must.
...I know. 'Preciate it.
You got 500 experience points.
You've still got a lot to learn. You're wanting in decisiveness, concentration, and accuracy.
Dunno what to say...
Come see me again when you've got more experience. As for the deer you shot, we'll share it with the village. That will show our gratitude for the animal's sacrifice.
You've kept up your shooting skills. I was right to give you that gun.
It's all thanks to you, Okudera-han. Hope ya keep on teachin' me.
Oh, I know it's all thanks to me, haha. As for the deer you shot, we'll share it with the village. That will show our gratitude for the animal's sacrifice.
What's wrong? This isn't like you. Buck up.
Dunno what's wrong with me...
I guess it can't be helped now. As for the deer you shot, we'll share it with the village. That will show our gratitude for the animal's sacrifice.
We owe ya so much. If not for you, Baba and I'd be bear food by now.
Yes, thank you so much!
I won't ask how you ended up here, completely lost with no explanation of where you came from.
I won't even ask what you plan to do once you get to the city.
But never forget this:
But never forget this, Saejima...
Killing is only justified during the hunt, or when protecting one's life. Do you understand?
I'll live by it.
Aniki... we, um, should go.
Take care, Okudera-han.
What is it, Saejima?
(We'll finish sayin' goodbye to Okudera-han, and then head to Tsukimino.)
It's nothin'.
Okay, then.
Kihachi's gone missin', and Nishina-han's out lookin' for him.
But Nishina-han ain't been back, and nobody else wants to go search for them. Guess I'll do it.
You think you know better than these people? They've lived on the mountain for decades.
Don't you think they might have a reason for not wanting to go?
(Hadn't thought of that, but...)
Of course, I can see you're not one for talking sense.
But you really might die. Do you understand that?
Yeah. I do.
Well then, go get your gear together. You can use my gun and shells. My only advice is that whatever happens out there... Stay alert.
Fine. Go, then.
Sakurai just told me about an outsider that went up the mountain.
It's Narumi. He must've already gone after Yama-oroshi.
Him too? Huh.
...What, you're just gonna ignore 'im?
He'll be back... not with his quarry, but at least with his life. And he'll be thankful for that much!
Hopefully... The guy knows nothin' about the mountain. Likely to get lost.

That's his own damned fault. But... I guess it
would be bad for the village.
Well, then I'll go look for 'im. I'm well enough.
If you think so...
From now on, use this rifle.
You got a Vertical Double Rifle.
You take care.
Sure will.
Let me know when you're ready.
Yeah, all set.
Fine, get your gear sorted.
Use the gun Narumi left. It shoots transmitters.
Remember, you're going up against Yama-oroshi... All I can say is, try not to die.
Good advice.
I can't hold a gun yet, so I'm counting on you.
I know.
Fine. Off we go.
Which gun do you want?
The Horizontal Double Rifle is now equipped.
The Vertical Double Rifle is now equipped.
The Vertical Double Special is now equipped.
The Vertical Double Rifle (Extreme) is now equipped.
The Golden Rifle is now equipped.
You're leaving?
But I might be back... Still gotta wheedle out of ya why you hate Yama-oroshi so much.
Hmph. Do as you please.
Tell me when you're ready.
Aniki, what did the road look like?
Seems like they finally got it open.
That's a relief. We should get going.
You're not hurtin' anymore?
I'm much better, thanks to you. I can make it down the mountain, at least.
I can't let you keep taking care of me like this. Since the road's open, let's leave for Tsukimino as soon as we can.
Baba-chan, how ya feelin'?
Much better, thanks to you. I can make it down the mountain, at least.
Let's go when the road re-opens.
All right. Jus' don't overexert yourself.
I'm sorry to be such a burden, Aniki. My stupid body just won't move right.
Not to worry. Nothin' ya can do except heal up.
I'm sorry, Aniki...
Oh, Aniki.
How're ya feelin'?
I... I can't really move yet. I'm so sorry for holding you up. You should be in Tsukimino already.
Don't worry about it. The road's snowed in anyway. We're gonna be guests of this village for a while.
Just take your time restin' up. Got that?
Welcome back, Aniki. I feel rotten for being the reason why you gotta hunt in the cold...
I wish I didn't have to be laid up. I'm so sorry.
It's nothin' to apologize for.
Can ya wait just a bit longer?
Okay. I'll wait right here. Just tell me when you're ready.
Yeah. All set.
Then we should be going.
Sure. On the way, let's figure out how to get close to Kitakata.
Now that I think about it, security around the site is only going to get tighter.
Aniki. We should travel separately so we can slip by them more easily.
Good idea. Just don't do nothin' crazy on yer own, Baba-chan.
I won't. Well, I'll be going, then.
(All right, I'll have to get myself to the site soon...)
Tomorrow's going to be hectic. We should get some sleep.
Sorry, got somethin' to do still.
Okay. Just tell me when you're done.
Gotcha.
You're right. Sleep it is.
Hey. Okay to talk?
Old-timer, can ya hear me?
Ah! Startled me, there.
Sorry. Didn't mean to scare ya.
It's fine, it's fine. I was just nodding off.
Careful with that. Fella could freeze to death fallin' asleep here.
Haha, and what does that matter? I'm never getting out. Hardly makes a difference whether I die today or twenty years from now.
(Cheerful guy, this one.)
So! What did you want?
Was lookin' for Baba, the kid I share a cell with. Seen 'im?
Baba...?
You don't know him?
You get to my age, the memory goes. It's hard matching names to faces.
